snippet.title: Timo The Game - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
[ENG]
Travel with Timo through fantastic books in this point and click adventure and help him go back to the real world! Winner and partially funded by the KO HQ contest. Best Kids Game nominee at the BIG Festival 2019. Selected by the Google Indie Game Accelerator program 2019.

[PT-BR]
Viaje com Timo através de livros fantásticos nessa aventura "point and click" e ajude ele a voltar para o mundo real! Vencedor e parcialmente financiado pelo concurso KO HQ. Indicado ao prêmio de Melhor Jogo Infantil no BIG Festival 2019. Selecionado pelo programa Google Indie Game Accelerator em 2019.
